  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 25, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on January 25, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on January 11, 2024.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Doris Obih DBA 40 Love Foundation / SCTA to host a Black History Month Event at 700
  Warren Ln.; Edward Vincent Jr. Park / Donald bBly Tennis Complex, Public Property, on
  Saturday, February 17, 2024, from 10:00 a.m – 3:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all
  recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planning Department Department; Applicant
  Approved for one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park Jr.; Applicant to hire (2)
  Professional Licensed Security Guards for the safety of attendees and employees; All
  Security Guards / Event Staff shall wear reflective vests; Security Guards must monitor the
  restrooms to prevent lewd acts; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00383388)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #3:  Ingrid Hernandez DB El Coco Market LLC to operate as a tobacco retailer at 611 E.
  Fairview Blvd. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition
  set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee: Must adhere to all City of Inglewood
  Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR
  BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS; Must adhere to all
  State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Sales or display of single cigarettes is strictly
  prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored
  Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos,
  Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-
  your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored
  Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited; Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette
  products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any
  related tobacco products shall have a valid government-issued identification on their
  person at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use, including
  hookah products; Sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives,
  pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police or Code
  Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for
  Community Public Health & Safety; California State Board of Equalization Tobacco
  Retailers license must be current; Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY; NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco
  products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of
  underage tobacco use, including hookah products; Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable; NO loitering of persons outside of the location; NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
 Permits & License Committee  January 25, 2024

  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.); 16. Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); and 17. The following is not allowed
  inside the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. ( Activity No. 00383454)
